findings.area: agenda row (Fredag 23. oktober, VfB Stuttgart – Borussia Mönchengladbach)
findings.issue: Team name wraps to three lines with only the single letter "h" (end of "Mönchengladbach") stranded alone on the third line. Nothing is hidden or truncated, just an awkward wrap — cosmetic only.

notes: Reviewed full-page screenshots at 375/393/900px plus closer scrolled crops of the 375/393 agenda at viewport resolution, and the very bottom of the page at 375/393.
No truncation that hides key info anywhere scanned — fixture names (incl. Norwegian clubs: Sandefjord, Bodø/Glimt–Vålerenga, Viking TIF, Aston Villa–Viking) read in full.
Channel column is honest and consistently Norwegian: TV 2 Play, Viaplay, TV 2, HBO Max (Sport); unknowns show a plain '–' rather than guessing. No ESPN/FOX/Sky spotted.
Crests/flags render correctly; non-team events (Sölden alpine skiing, Elverum–ØIF Arendal handball) correctly fall back to a generic calendar/snowflake glyph instead of a broken image box.
Must-see accent dots are sparing (roughly 1 in 4-5 rows) and track Norwegian teams/importance, not applied everywhere.
No horizontal scroll or clipped edges at any of the three widths, including the hardest 375px case.
Floating Assistent button overlaps a mid-agenda row (e.g. 'Club Brugge – Lens' at 900px) at a given scroll position — this is the DESIGN.md-sanctioned floating-button idiom, not flagged.

Checked the one real Assistent-button guarantee directly: at the very bottom of the page (375px and 393px) the footer ('Oppdatert …', 'Abonner i kalender', AI-budsjett line) is fully visible and NOT occluded by the button — holds.
Header, day headings ('I dag', 'I morgen', weekday+date headers), 'Dette dekker vi' / 'Merker og kilder' disclosures, and footer all intact and aligned at every width.
Live-now section ('DIREKTE NÅ') and the quiet single editorial headline line under the date both render as intended, one quiet line each.
